violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 Years and More Than 40 Pounds; 5 - 7 Years and Under 4 Feet, 9 Inches (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 Years and More Than 40 Pounds; 5 - 7 Years and Under 4 Feet, 9 Inches
violation_type.typical_finding: During the monitoring inspection the transportation vehicle was not equipped with child safety seats and transported children daily between the ages of 4-7 years old.

finding_variants.text: During the monitoring inspection the transportation vehicle was not equipped with child safety seats and transported children daily between the ages of 4-7 years old.
Two five years old were observed transported by the operation staff without a booster seat.
At the time of the inspection safety seats were not being used for all children who required them.
